name: School Lesson
source:
Main character is a coach for the swimming club. New member Aoi Sakashita can not swim at all, so she requires private lessons until she can reliably swim by herself. But protagonist can not resist temptation and loses self-control leading to an affair with the girl.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是游泳部的教练。新成员坂下葵完全不会游泳，因此在能够独立、稳定地游起来之前，她需要接受一对一指导。然而，主人公最终没能抵挡诱惑，失去理智，与少女发生了关系。

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
